WITH noticeType AS ( SELECT sys09_code noticeType_cd , sys09_name noticeType_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'NoticeType' AND sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{c.companyId} END ), noticeDetail AS ( SELECT sys09_code noticeDetail_cd , sys09_name noticeDetail_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'NoticeDetailCode' AND sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{c.companyId} END ), bbs AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * , CONCAT(bbs02_notice_type_nm, bbs02_notice_detail_nm) AS bbs02_notice_detail_full_nm , ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(bbs02_top_notice_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN CASE WHEN f_today() <= bbs02_top_notice_close_date THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ELSE 'false' END ) AS bbs02_top_yn FROM ( SELECT bbs02_notice.* , '<'||'b '||CASE WHEN bbs02_notice_type = '90' /*(90:시스템공지)*/ THEN 'style=color:#E33E31;' ELSE 'style=color:#4B81B9;' END ||'>'|| '['||noticeType_nm||'] ' '<'||'/b'||'>' AS bbs02_notice_type_nm , noticeDetail_nm AS bbs02_notice_detail_nm , '<'||'b '||CASE WHEN bbs02_notice_type = '90' /*(90:시스템공지)*/ THEN 'style=color:#E33E31;' ELSE 'style=color:#4B81B9;' END ||'>'|| '['||noticeType_nm||'] ' '<'||'/b'||'>'||bbs02_title AS bbs02_title2 , 3 AS bbs02_seq FROM bbs02_notice LEFT OUTER JOIN bbs04_target_company ON ( bbs04_notice_id = bbs02_notice_id AND bbs04_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeType ON noticeType_cd = bbs02_notice_type LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeDetail ON noticeDetail_cd = bbs02_notice_detail_cd WHERE ( bbs02_public_company_yn = 'true' OR bbs04_target_company_id IS NOT NULL ) AND COALESCE(bbs02_public_yn, 'true') = 'true' AND bbs02_notice_type IN ( SELECT sys09_code FROM sys13_code_group INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_id = sys13_code_id WHERE sys13_kind_group_cd = 'NoticeType002' ) AND ( ( /*** (9010:관리자공지)인 경우 관리자권한에 등록되어 있는 사용자만 조회되도록 함 ***/ COALESCE(bbs02_notice_detail_cd,'') = '9010' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys04_role INNER JOIN sys05_user_role ON sys05_role_id = sys04_role_id WHERE sys04_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND sys04_admin_yn = 'true' AND sys05_user_id = #{c.personId} ) ) OR ( COALESCE(bbs02_notice_detail_cd,'') != '9010' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT bbs02_notice.* , '<'||'b '||'style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'||'[(회사)전체공지] ' '<'||'/b'||'>' AS bbs02_notice_type_nm , noticeDetail_nm AS bbs02_notice_detail_nm , '<'||'b '||'style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'|| '[(회사)전체공지] ' '<'||'/b'||'>'||bbs02_title AS bbs02_title2 , 1 AS bbs02_seq FROM bbs02_notice LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeDetail ON noticeDetail_cd = bbs02_notice_detail_cd WHERE bbs02_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND bbs02_notice_type = '01' /*(01:(회사)전체공지)*/ UNION ALL SELECT bbs02_notice.* , '<'||'b '||'style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'||'[(회사)개별공지] ' '<'||'/b'||'>' AS bbs02_notice_type_nm , noticeDetail_nm AS bbs02_notice_detail_nm , '<'||'b '||'style=color:#E33E31;'||'>'|| '[(회사)개별공지] ' '<'||'/b'||'>'||bbs02_title AS bbs02_title2 , 1 AS bbs02_seq FROM bbs02_notice LEFT OUTER JOIN noticeDetail ON noticeDetail_cd = bbs02_notice_detail_cd WHERE bbs02_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND bbs02_notice_type = '02' /*(02:(회사)개별공지)*/ AND bbs02_notice_id IN ( SELECT bbs03_notice_id FROM bbs03_target WHERE bbs03_person_id = #{c.personId} ) ) bbs WHERE bbs02_open_yn = '알림' AND bbs02_notice_type LIKE #{c.noticeType} AND COALESCE(bbs02_notice_detail_cd,'') LIKE #{c.noticeDetailCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(bbs02_notice_no, bbs02_notice_type_nm, bbs02_notice_detail_nm, bbs02_title)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) ) bbs_in WHERE 1=1
AND ( ( bbs02_top_yn = 'false' AND bbs02_from_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate}::date AND #{c.closeDate}::date ) OR ( bbs02_top_yn != 'false' AND bbs02_from_date <= f_today() ) )
AND bbs02_from_date <= f_today()
)
